description: This file contains unit tests for the CordRepBtreeNavigator class in the Abseil library, testing navigation, reading, and boundary conditions on a tree structure used for string storage.

classes.name: CordRepBtreeNavigatorTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing CordRepBtreeNavigator navigation logic with various tree sizes.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of data edges in the test tree.

methods.name: tree
methods.description: Returns the test tree being used.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns the generated string data for the test.

methods.name: flats
methods.description: Returns the vector of flat CordRep pointers used in the test.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts test parameter info to a string for naming test cases.
